description: Defines the CookieOptions class and nested SameSiteCookieContext class, including enums and metadata related to cookie security contexts, cross-site considerations, and HTTP methods. It provides interfaces for configuring cookie access options in the Chromium project.

classes.name: CookieOptions
classes.description: Represents options for cookie access, including security context, HttpOnly exclusion, and other flags.

methods.name: set_exclude_httponly
methods.description: Exclude HttpOnly cookies from access.

methods.name: set_include_httponly
methods.description: Include HttpOnly cookies in access.

methods.name: exclude_httponly
methods.description: Check if HttpOnly cookies are excluded.

methods.name: set_same_site_cookie_context
methods.description: Set the context for SameSite cookie inclusion.

methods.name: same_site_cookie_context
methods.description: Get the current SameSite cookie context.

methods.name: set_update_access_time
methods.description: Update last-accessed time on cookie access.

methods.name: set_do_not_update_access_time
methods.description: Do not update last-accessed time.

methods.name: update_access_time
methods.description: Check if access time will be updated.

methods.name: set_return_excluded_cookies
methods.description: Set flag to return excluded cookies.

methods.name: unset_return_excluded_cookies
methods.description: Unset flag to return excluded cookies.

methods.name: return_excluded_cookies
methods.description: Check if excluded cookies are returned.

methods.name: set_same_party_context
methods.description: Set the SamePartyContext.

methods.name: same_party_context
methods.description: Get the SamePartyContext.

methods.name: set_full_party_context_size
methods.description: Set the size of the full party context for logging.

methods.name: full_party_context_size
methods.description: Get the size of the full party context.

methods.name: set_is_in_nontrivial_first_party_set
methods.description: Set whether the site is in a nontrivial first-party set.

methods.name: is_in_nontrivial_first_party_set
methods.description: Check if in a nontrivial first-party set.

methods.name: MakeAllInclusive
methods.description: Create a CookieOptions instance that includes all cookies, including HttpOnly and SameSite.

classes.name: SameSiteCookieContext
classes.description: Represents the context for SameSite cookie policies, including trust levels and metadata about the context.

methods.name: GetContextForCookieInclusion
methods.description: Get the context type used for cookie inclusion decisions.

methods.name: GetMetadataForCurrentSchemefulMode
methods.description: Get metadata about the context considering schemeful mode.

methods.name: context
methods.description: Get the context type.

methods.name: schemeful_context
methods.description: Get the schemeful context type.

methods.name: metadata
methods.description: Get the context metadata.

methods.name: schemeful_metadata
methods.description: Get the schemeful context metadata.

methods.name: SetContextTypesForTesting
methods.description: Set context types for testing purposes.

methods.name: CompleteEquivalenceForTesting
methods.description: Check if two contexts are completely equivalent.

enums.name: ContextType
enums.description: Trust level of the environment for cookie access.

enums.name: ContextDowngradeType
enums.description: Type of downgrade due to cross-site redirects.

enums.name: ContextRedirectTypeBug1221316
enums.description: Redirect type for metrics related to redirect behavior.

structs.name: ContextMetadata
structs.description: Metadata about the context, including downgrade type, redirect type, and HTTP method.
